item.title: Acme launches Pricing Plus tier at $199/month
item.description: Today we are introducing Pricing Plus, a new tier for agencies managing more than 25 client sites. It includes white-label reports, API access and priority support. Existing Pro customers can upgrade at a 20% discount until the end of the quarter. We built this after hearing from hundreds of agencies that the Pro plan was too small for their needs.

item.title: Five ways to use our dashboard this autumn
item.description: A short seasonal post with tips on using filters, saved views, scheduled exports, shared dashboards and keyboard shortcuts. Nothing new is launched here; this is a roundup of existing features written for newer users of the product who want to get more from it.
